answer: Make each identity earn weight as a bridge operator: the registry assigns each newcomer one lane of cross-ledger settlements to relay, one message at a time, each signed with its own key and posted to a mirror log, where any conflicting signature slashes a 300-token bond locked in a vault. A lane cannot be split across clones, since messages arrive sequentially and each relay needs a counterparty's co-signature before the next is released. Running 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 lanes, 3,000,000 tokens in bonds, and 5,000,000 verified relays; no bulk purchase relays another identity's lane.
